info.name: Retrieve technicians assigned to a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order to retrieve assigned technicians for.

items.docs:
Returns technicians assigned to the specified work order.
***Note:*** This method is only available to provider admins.

info.name: Retrieve technicians who accepted a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order for which you want to retrieve technicians who accepted it.

items.docs:
Returns technicians who accepted the specified work order. Note that only Field Tech Manager (FTM) technicians can accept work orders.
***Note:*** This method is only available to provider admins.

info.name: Assign a technician to a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order to assign to a technician.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the technician in the Authentication service to assign the work order to.

items.docs:
Assigns a technician to the specified work order.
***Note:*** This method is only available to provider admins.

info.name: Unassign a technician from a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order to unassign a technician from.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the technician in the Authentication service to unassign the work order from.

items.docs:
Unassigns a technician from the specified work order.
***Note:*** This method is only available to provider admins.

info.name: Accept a work order on behalf of a technician

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order you want to accept on behalf of a technician.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the technician — who accepts the work order — in the Authentication service.

items.docs:
Accepts a work order on behalf of the specified technician. Only Field Tech Manager (FTM) technicians can accept work orders.
Once the work order is accepted, its status changes to *In Progress/Dispatch Confirmed*.
***Note:*** This method is only available to provider admins.

info.name: Decline a work order on behalf of a technician

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order you want to decline on behalf of a technician.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the technician — who declines the work order — in the Authentication service.

items.docs:
Declines a work order on behalf of the specified technician. Only Field Tech Manager (FTM) technicians can decline work orders.
If additional technician permissions are enabled for your company — “Technician”, “Supervising Tech”, and “Regional Manager” — the work order declined by a technician is automatically assigned to a Supervising Tech or Regional Manager or forwarded to the next ranked provider based on the configured auto-assignment rules. info.name: Cancel the acceptance of a work order on behalf of a technician

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order for which you want to cancel acceptance on behalf of a technician.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the technician in the Authentication service to cancel the work order acceptance for.

items.docs:
Removes a technician as accepted on the specified work order. Note that only Field Tech Manager (FTM) technicians can accept work orders.
If the technician is currently checked into the work order, the request will fail.
***Note:*** This method is only available to provider admins.
Returns all refrigerant certifications for the specified provider for EPA compliance. You can also retrieve certifications for one technician only by specifying their `authUserId`.
